sourceContract.rule: Every text node and control with position and computed styles, matched by text or accessible role+name. Repeated identical diffs are reported once, grouped by pattern.

redFirstChronology: The typed scaffold exported the final capture/difference types and returned [] so every failing test was an assertion failure, not a missing-module/setup error.
The original RED log was produced before any behavior existed and was not regenerated or reconstructed.
Behavior was added only after the RED log and hashes below were recorded.

red.failureClass: assertion failures only; no module-resolution or setup failures

refactor.note: Compaction-only refactor; test file hash unchanged.

antiSlopLint.detail: Not exposed as a callable tool to this worker. No PATH probe was used as an availability check.

coverage.identicalCapture: 25-test suite includes identical text/control captures and empty/empty.
coverage.repeatedIdentityAndCounts: Repeated text and control occurrences, order-only changes, geometry pairing, missing/extra repeated counts.
coverage.controlLoss: Accessible name, role, text/control kind, geometry, and style-loss findings.
coverage.emptySnapshots: Empty expected and empty actual snapshots.
coverage.orderOnly: Node-array order is ignored when identity and geometry agree; reversed repeated style changes produce the same grouped output.
coverage.grouping: Repeated identical style patterns are reported once with count and expected/actual indexes.
coverage.tolerance: Default zero rejects 0.01px and 5px changes; only an explicit tolerance is applied.
coverage.styles: Style key order is canonicalized; repeated style keys produce invalid_capture.
coverage.payload: Findings never contain captured text or style values.

adapterLimitation: Pure typed comparator only. A later adapter owns the actual DOM/text/control walk and computed-style property list. No browser, React self-check, pixel comparison, or full-parity claim is made here.
